read.notes: Compiler: pinned E:/COBOL-wt/coderead85-tree-d (commit 24372b7b17, PR #1704). The pointer rows' conformance cases were all run at --std 2002 with probes-u-20/run.py; the log is probes-u-20/cases-2002.txt. Every citation below was checked with scripts/spec/cite.py --check (probes-u-20/cites.py, results cites.json; the definition citation re-checked as §2002:4). AcceptDifferentialTests compile at dialect 85 by default (some at 2023) and HostEntryTests at 2023 (NonCobolElement.CompileCobol dialect = 2023): neither runs at 2002, so for those rows the probes here are what shows the behaviour at 2002. Communication-section reach is judged as the earlier p-15, p-16 and q-24 reads did: an identifier operand of a 2002 statement may reference a data item of a record under a CD (§2002:A.1.1.2), and a CALL argument or RETURNING item may be one by name (§2002:14.8.4.2 SR3 and SR7).

cases.reason: 2002's 'standard arithmetic' is ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD, the 32-digit truncating model of 2002 8.8.1.3, not 2023's standard-decimal/standard-binary. The row cannot show it. Probe: ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD; C PIC S9(31) VALUE -10**30; ADD 10**30 and twenty times H (PIC SV99 VALUE .05) TO C. Each partial sum 10**30 + 0.05 has 33 significant digits; truncated to 32 it stays 10**30, so C must end 0. The pinned compiler gives +1 at 2002 (and at 2014), the 34-digit model. This is kb/Work PB5575 (known; its run-time arm landed on main after this tree, DEVLOG 3690): re-probe on main. Operands may also be CD items (probe correct).

cases.reason: Only 'MSCS' is spelt out in 2023. FOREVER has no operand, so the CD reach that overturned GR1/GR2/GR4 cannot apply. The 2002 statements carrying retry-phrase (DELETE, OPEN, READ, REWRITE, WRITE) are a subset of 2023's (2023 adds DELETE FILE). The own-run-unit hold (returns the conflict status at once) rests on the deadlock text, which is word-identical in 2002 9.1.12.7 and 2023 9.1.13.8, and B.1 item 85 = A.1 item 109; 2002 has no commit/rollback that could release a lock mid-statement, so the 2023 reasoning (an inside holder cannot release while the statement executes) holds at 2002.
